description: Propose a new blueprint (a group of tasks: title, goal, exit criteria, notes), or a change to one (name it in blueprint; fields you leave out keep their current value). Agents propose blueprints, never create or change them: it waits for the user in harness ui, Work › Inbox, who approves it (the blueprint is made or restated) or rejects it. Tasks you propose for a new one name it by its title (task_propose blueprint): whichever is approved first, they end up in it. Only when it was already approved outside harness, name that approver in approved_by: the blueprint is then made or restated at once, recorded as approved by them.

blueprint.description: the id of the blueprint to change; leave out to propose a new one

title.description: its name (required for a new blueprint)

goal.description: what its tasks are for (required for a new blueprint)

exit.description: when it is done: criteria that can be checked, one per entry

reason.description: why you propose it: what you saw, where

approved_by.description: only when the work was already approved outside harness (a change board, a ticket, the user in this conversation): who approved it. It is then approved at once in their name, without the Inbox; leave out otherwise, the default

same_name.description: with approved_by, when a blueprint of the new one's title exists: merge (restate that one) or new (a separate blueprint); without it such an approval is refused

name: task_blueprint_propose

blueprint_id.description: the blueprint made or restated when approved_by was given
